svg.aria-label: TrustLens Keep-warm: a scheduled GitHub Action that curls the backend health endpoint every ten minutes so Render's free tier never sleeps.
svg.title: TrustLens Keep-warm
svg.desc: One workflow, one curl. Every ten minutes it requests the TrustLens backend health endpoint, because Render's free tier sleeps after fifteen minutes idle and the next scan would pay a cold start. GitHub disables a scheduled workflow after sixty days with no pushes, and the cron itself does not count, so only a commit re-arms it.
